Command output summary with exit codes:
- Sidecar upgrade exited 0.
- Canvas Helper typecheck exited 0 through current-worktree STAX command evidence.

What is verified:
- `AGENTS.md` now tells agents to prefer `--url <local-preview-url>` when a local preview is running so STAX captures the screenshot itself.
- `.stax/prompt-contract.json` now lists `npm run stax:collect-visual -- --repo <repo> --url <local-preview-url> ...` and the fallback `--path <screenshot.png>` registration path.
- `.stax/proof-surfaces.candidate.json` was regenerated locally as candidate-only discovery output.
- Current-worktree command evidence exists for Canvas Helper `npm run typecheck`.

What is weak/provisional:
- This updates sidecar guidance only; it does not certify a new course page or hosted page.
- The regenerated proof-surface candidate remains candidate-only unless approved separately.

What is unverified:
- No Canvas source or Studio UI code was changed.
- No new screenshot was captured in this sidecar protocol update.
- No protected live action was run.

Risks:
- Generated `.stax` status/proof/report files are still local sidecar artifacts.
- Existing approved proof surfaces were not re-approved in this step.

One next action:
Run the Canvas Helper STAX sidecar gate for this sidecar protocol update and keep the changed protocol files if it accepts.
